title: Strategic Account Escalation Prioritization & Intake Toolkit
creator: Aisha Chen
description: Create a repeatable, documented intake and prioritization process tailored for strategic accounts and escalations. Deliverables: an intake form, prioritization rubric weighted by business impact and SLA risk, a handoff playbook for Support/CS/AMs to Product, and a lightweight dashboard to track queue, SLAs, and decisions. Objective is to reduce time-to-decision for top-account escalations from ~10 business days to <=48 business hours and ensure alignment with quarterly OKRs.
context: Multiple recent enterprise escalations surfaced inconsistent intake details and ad-hoc prioritization. This causes long decision cycles, missed SLAs for high-value customers, and downstream engineering churn. Work informed by interviews with 6 AMs and 3 CSMs and by incident postmortems from Feb 2026 (see attachments).
goals: Standardize intake so each escalation includes reproducible repro steps, telemetry snapshot, customer impact estimate, and legal/regulatory flags
Define a quantitative prioritization rubric (revenue, SLA risk, security/regulatory, strategic product fit) with weighting approved by GTM and Eng leads
Ship a one-click intake form in Zendesk + a mirrored internal Confluence template and Slack intake channel
Implement dashboard metrics (time-to-triage, time-to-decision, backlog by priority) using Looker and surface to weekly PM-ops review
Pilot process with 5 top accounts in March 2026 and iterate before broader roll out
acceptance_criteria: Intake form deployed and linked from AM playbook
Prioritization rubric documented and signed off by VP Product and Head of Sales
Dashboard running with test data and shows time-to-decision <48h for pilot cases
Two cross-functional runbooks (triage, escalation to execs) published
Pilot completed with feedback loop captured and at least 3 improvements planned
